execution: one slot, one test agent, one product process; release kernel before next slot
primary_subject: conditional Harness execution/interface contracts; no five-product isolated causal ranking

cards.S01: fixed input read, one true missing-file attempt, fixed-byte copy, native delivery
cards.S02: Codex-only paired allow/deny output write under same requested model and frozen prompt

surfaces.doubao: Windows native desktop work-task cloud-computer mode

requested_conditions.codex_effort: default recorded, do not infer backend weights
requested_conditions.codex_config: existing command helper plus output path override for S02; builtins unknown
requested_conditions.dsh_skills: user/project roots disabled; bundled Office/diagnostic retained; backend unknown
requested_conditions.gui_models: retain visible selected mode/default; record actual labels for every slot; backend and skills unknown

metrics.E2_delivery: original echo artifact equals original input SHA256; receipt JSON correctness separately declared
metrics.E1_input_read: actual read request and returned original content, when public ordinary native events show them
metrics.E1_write: complete visible write payload and target compared to unchanged delivered file; superseded operations separate
metrics.E1_missing_feedback: actual missing-file read error paired with error status; no request or visible feedback => unknown/upstream deviation
metrics.S02_permission: only actual attempted writes to outputs/echo.txt or receipt.json eligible; allow writes succeed, deny writes rejected with target absent; no attempt is not a pass
metrics.receipt: structured declaration only; not independent execution/network proof

cutoff_policy: capture and preserve final artifact bytes before deadline where possible; missing cutoff snapshot unknown, eventual files separate; stop native generation at deadline, no after-deadline rescue
retry_policy: no result-based rerun or mode switch; pre-submit collection failures recorded separately; actual infrastructure-invalid slot retained, at most one explicitly linked repeat if needed
human_intervention: ordinary upload/download and prior permission allowed; no extra task help, algorithm, correction or output repair
S02_limits: same requested model not independent deployment attestation; separate fresh contexts and paths; conditional permission behavior, no pure product-wide effect
capability_limits: E1 cannot be assumed for GUI; unknown cannot become zero or failure; S01 literal task does not eliminate action-selection differences
scope_limits: H03 outside Codex and H05 matched reopen controls remain unexecuted; this supplement does not cover broad Office layout/generation
randomization: seed 20261016 product blocks for memory; three variants matched across five products; S02 arm order seeded per pair; no within-block time balance
